entry.title: Crate Press 0.2.6
entry.summary: # Crate Press 0.2.6 Generate a restrained new effect character with Roll Dice, protect individual controls and undo the result. The same UNLOCK ALL / ROLL DICE / UNDO row appears on all five pages. - Randomise thirteen character controls; preserve Input/Output/Mix, safety, LATCH and all performance gates/settings. - Share each lock between MAIN and detail views. Final lock silhouette and padding match Donut Theory; 44×44 touch targets remain. - Respond immediately on stopped or empty audio track
